title: Pristimerin disrupts blood-testis barrier (BTB) integrity via ferroptosis and apoptosis by the NUR77/ATF3/CHOP pathway.
authors: Li, Jiaqi; Chen, Haoyu; Lu, Zhengxin; Ma, Yuanbiao; Li, Shanshan; Chen, Zhiyu; Deng, Zhewen; Zhang, Qi; Ma, Bo
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然化合物Pristimerin通过NUR77/ATF3/CHOP通路诱导铁死亡和凋亡破坏血睾屏障，虽含分子对接和MD模拟，但核心是化合物-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: Pristimerin (Pri), a natural triterpenoid from the Celastraceae family, exhibits potent anti-tumor and anti-inflammatory activities, yet its further development as a drug candidate is hampered by severe male reproductive toxicity and precise target cells and underlying mechanisms remain unclear. Therefore, this study aimed to identify the target cells and elucidate these mechanisms. In vivo, male mice were administered Pri to evaluate testicular injury, sperm quality, and BTB integrity, while LC-MS/MS was used to detect Pri distribution in testis, epididymis, and sperm, as well as its cellular uptake. In vitro, CCK-8 assessed cell viability, and inhibitor interventions identified contributions of distinct cell death pathways. Annexin V/PI, C11-BODIPY, and DCFH-DA/DHE were used to assess apoptosis and ferroptosis-related oxidative damage. Transcriptomics, RT-qPCR, Western blotting, and immunohistochemistry were performed to examine activation of the NUR77-ATF3-CHOP axis and molecular docking, MD simulations, CETSA, and siRNA-mediated knockdown validated direct NUR77 binding by Pri. Pri exposure induced testicular atrophy, BTB disruption, and sperm impairment, with accumulation in reproductive tissues. In vitro, Pri inhibited TM4 cell viability. Cell death was partially rescued by Z-VAD-FMK and Fer-1, indicating that Pri triggers apoptosis and ferroptosis. Mechanistically, Pri activated the NUR77-ATF3-CHOP axis and directly bound to NUR77, as confirmed by docking, MD simulations, and CETSA. Knockdown of NUR77 improved cell viability and suppressed Pri-induced ATF3 upregulation. Collectively, this study demonstrates that Pri directly targets NUR77, activating the NUR77-ATF3-CHOP axis and inducing both apoptosis and ferroptosis in Sertoli cells, leading to spermatogenesis dysfunction, thereby providing critical insights into Pri-induced testicular injury.
abstract_zh: Pristimerin (Pri) 是一种来自卫矛科 (Celastraceae) 的天然三萜类化合物，具有强效的抗肿瘤和抗炎活性，但其作为候选药物的进一步开发受到严重雄性生殖毒性的阻碍，且精确靶细胞及潜在机制尚不清楚。因此，本研究旨在识别靶细胞并阐明这些机制。在体内实验中，雄性小鼠给予Pri以评估睾丸损伤、精子质量和BTB完整性，同时使用LC-MS/MS检测Pri在睾丸、附睾和精子中的分布及其细胞摄取。在体外实验中，CCK-8评估细胞活力，抑制剂干预识别不同细胞死亡通路的贡献。使用Annexin V/PI、C11-BODIPY和DCFH-DA/DHE评估凋亡和铁死亡相关氧化损伤。通过转录组学、RT-qPCR、Western blotting和免疫组织化学检测NUR77-ATF3-CHOP轴的激活，并通过分子对接、分子动力学 (molecular dynamics, MD) 模拟、CETSA和siRNA介导的敲低验证Pri对NUR77的直接结合。Pri暴露诱导睾丸萎缩、BTB破坏和精子损伤，并在生殖组织中积累。在体外，Pri抑制TM4细胞活力。细胞死亡被Z-VAD-FMK和Fer-1部分挽救，表明Pri触发凋亡和铁死亡。机制上，Pri激活NUR77-ATF3-CHOP轴并直接结合NUR77，这通过对接、MD模拟和CETSA得到确认。NUR77敲低改善细胞活力并抑制Pri诱导的ATF3上调。总体而言，本研究证明Pri直接靶向NUR77，激活NUR77-ATF3-CHOP轴并在支持细胞 (Sertoli cells) 中诱导凋亡和铁死亡，导致精子发生功能障碍，从而为Pri诱导的睾丸损伤提供关键见解。
